design.purge: drop training rows whose [date, exit_date] intersects a test group's [first, last] test date
design.embargo: drop training rows dated within 22 sessions after each test group's last test date
design.holdout: rows dated in the holdout window never trained on or scored; training rows whose label exit date is on or after the holdout's first session are dropped
design.robust_rule: positive net (20 bps) excess vs EW in >= 6 of 7 paths, read separately for the vol+size-neutral full-universe top decile and the liquid-tercile top decile

caveat: CPCV trains on months after the test window by design: it measures path dependence, not forward performance
